line: **Chittoor Palegars' revolts:** **Nagapeta, Sandurkonda, Mogilighaut, Magaralakonda, Ganigabanda**; from 1763 to 1856 Andhra saw **over 40 major rebellions**, the biggest being **Vuyyalavada Narasimha Reddy's (1846)**.

**Moojawadi (Kadapa):** the **Tripurantakam inscription (1250 CE)** records **Kayastha Gangaya Sahani** appointed **Bahattara Niyogadhipathi** and **Governor of Moojawadi (Kadapa)**; the Kayasthas were masters of the Kadapa (Moojawadi) region.
**Varahapurana:** written by **Nandi Mallaya and Ghanta Singanna (Singaya)** and **dedicated to Tuluva Narasa Nayaka**; it calls Thimmaraju **'Devaki Puradhipuda'**.

mcq.s: Varahapurana, written by Nandi Mallaya and Ghanta Singanna, was dedicated to whom?
mcq.x: Nandi Mallaya and Ghanta Singanna dedicated the Varahapurana to Tuluva Narasa Nayaka, father of Krishnadevaraya.

line: **Korivi Mandal:** the early **Kakatiyas** were associated with **Korivi Mandal**, with **Orugallu (Warangal)** on its border; **Eriya Rashtrakuta** ruled Korivi Mandal from **Orugallu Kakatipuram**.
**Vaija Dandadhipa (Vaijadandadhipu):** minister of **Beta II**, a master of politics; with his help Beta II subdued **Paramara Jagadeva of Kollipaka** and **Medaraju of Polavasa**.

mcq.s: Vaija Dandadhipa was the minister of which Kakatiya ruler?
mcq.x: Vaija Dandadhipa, minister of Beta II (Vikrama Chakri), helped him subdue Jagadeva of Kollipaka and Medaraju of Polavasa.

line: **Smithophis leptofasciatus (narrow-banded rain snake):** new **non-venomous** rain-loving snake species found in **Mizoram's** tropical forests by **Mizoram University** and **Help Earth** (Guwahati).

mcq.s: Smithophis leptofasciatus, a new non-venomous rain snake, was discovered in which state?
mcq.x: The narrow-banded rain snake was recorded in Mizoram's tropical forests by Mizoram University and Help Earth.

line: **DAANVEER:** Ministry of **Panchayati Raj** with **NIC** – lets citizens and organisations **donate verified digital-equipment bundles** to eligible **Gram Panchayats**; linked to **DigiHaat** and **Meri Panchayat**.

**GAETEC, Hyderabad (DRDO):** produces **indigenous GaN (Gallium Nitride) chips**; on **13 May 2026 SAMEER and ISRO's ISTRAC** agreed to build **X-band deep-space communication amplifiers** with them; DRDO's **SSPL** developed 4-inch **SiC** wafer processes.
**Dhvani:** **Hypersonic Glide Vehicle** under development by **DRDO**.
**Lyriothemis abrahami:** new **dragonfly** species discovered in **Kerala**.
**Cnemaspis brahmaputra:** new **gecko** species discovered in **Assam**, named after the **Brahmaputra**.
**Chambaghat (Solan district, Himachal Pradesh):** a large outcrop of **600-million-year-old stromatolites** (layered structures built by **cyanobacteria**) was discovered here.

**Piprahwa relics at Sotheby's:** in **May 2025** part of the relics kept by **Peppé's descendants** was listed for auction at **Sotheby's, Hong Kong**; the **Ministry of Culture** sent a legal notice (5 May) and the auction was **postponed** (7 May 2025).
**Orobanche aegyptiaca (Margoja):** has emerged as a hidden threat to **mustard** crops.
**GeodCon-26:** **first Indian National Conference on Geodesy**, **11–13 March 2026**, organised by **IIT Kanpur's National Centre for Geodesy**.

**ADGMIN:** the **6th ASEAN–India Digital Ministers' Meeting** was held in **virtual mode**, co-chaired by DoT Secretary **Amit Agarwal**; theme **"Adaptive ASEAN: From Connectivity to Connected Intelligence"**.

**Vitamin B12 from Spirulina:** scientists from **Iceland, Denmark and Austria** developed an eco-friendly method to produce **98% biologically active Vitamin B12** from the blue-green alga **Spirulina** – a non-animal source useful for **vegetarians**.
**Hargila Army:** **Assam's** community-led conservation model led by **Purnima Devi Barman**, now adapted in **Cambodia's Tonle Sap Biosphere Reserve**.

mcq.s: The 'Hargila Army' community conservation model of Assam has been adapted in which biosphere reserve?
mcq.x: The Hargila Army model led by Purnima Devi Barman was adapted for Cambodia's Tonle Sap Biosphere Reserve.

line: **Mount Lewotobi Laki Laki:** active **stratovolcano** on **Flores Island, Indonesia** (Pacific **Ring of Fire**) that erupted violently in 2025.
**Rhisotope Project:** **radioactive tagging** (isotope injection) of **rhino horns** to fight **poaching**.
